name: Ducati Multistrada 950 / V2
engine: 937 cc liquid-cooled Testastretta V-twin, fuel injected
intro: The smaller liquid-cooled Multistrada. A Testastretta twin, belt cams and a wet clutch.

H: Desmo valve service needs both opening and closing shims checked. Follow the interval in the manual; it is not a job to skip.
